summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on NFL, a 1989 football video game. It states that the game was developed by Atlus and published by LJN, and that it was released exclusively for the Nintendo Entertainment System.
one_line: NFL is a 1989 American football video game developed by Atlus and published by LJN for the Nintendo Entertainment System.
key_facts: NFL is a football video game.
NFL was released exclusively for the Nintendo Entertainment System.
